versions.name: Old Ben Scout Reservation
versions.address: 5735 E County Road 175 N, Winslow, IN 47598
versions.summary: A Buffalo Trace Council reservation in Pike County near Winslow in southwestern Indiana, on reclaimed Old Ben coal-mine land, with a lake, a waterfront and aqua park, named campsites, and a dining hall supporting resident and day-camp programs for Scouts and Cub Scouts.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from Buffalo Trace Council's own Old Ben Scout Reservation materials and current council camping pages, which confirm it as an active council reservation running Resource Camp, Cub Scout day camp, and Webelos overnight programs. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (matching the council's published event coordinates); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council (Buffalo Trace), and active operating status verified; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a reservation with resident, day, and Webelos camping; features unsurveyed.
